integrity: The subgroup lattice is reduced to the center, p+1 maximal subgroups, and p private order-p subgroups under each maximal subgroup. A necessary-and-sufficient forcing criterion is proved and counted exactly. The standalone checker exhausts all 131072 blue sets for p=3 and independently reconstructs Heisenberg subgroup intersections for p=3 and p=5.
scientific_limitations: The theorem assumes an odd-prime extraspecial group of order p^3 and exponent p.
Larger extraspecial groups and the exponent-p^2 group of order p^3 are not covered.
No minimum-rank or maximum-nullity equality is claimed.
title: Zero forcing polynomial of the subgroup-intersection graph of the exponent-\(p\) extraspecial group of order \(p^3\)
